title: Reset a customer's SSO access
body: 1. Find the user in the admin console. 2. Revoke active sessions. 3. Send a re-enrolment link. 4. Confirm MFA re-binds on next login.

title: Investigate wrong invoice totals
body: 1. Pull the billing run id. 2. Compare line items to the metering export. 3. Check for duplicate usage events. 4. Re-run reconciliation and notify finance.

title: Triage a production incident
body: 1. Declare severity. 2. Open an incident channel. 3. Assign an incident commander. 4. Mitigate first, root-cause later. 5. Post a timeline.

title: Payments service — connection pool exhaustion
body: 1. Check DB connection pool metrics in Grafana (dashboard: payments-db). 2. Kill idle connections: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle' AND query_start < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 min'. 3. Increase pool max_connections temporarily in payments config. 4. Restart payments pods one at a time. 5. Alert DBA team if pool exhaustion recurs within 30 min.

title: Auth service — high error rate / token validation failures
body: 1. Check auth service logs for JWT decode errors (Loki: service=auth level=error). 2. Verify the signing key has not rotated unexpectedly (check secrets manager). 3. If key mismatch: re-deploy auth service with correct key, all active tokens will need re-issue. 4. Alert security team if key rotation was unplanned.

title: API gateway — 5xx spike
body: 1. Check upstream service health in k8s: kubectl get pods -n production. 2. Identify the failing upstream from gateway access logs. 3. Roll back the last deployment if the spike correlates with a recent deploy. 4. Enable circuit breaker in gateway config if upstream is flapping. 5. Notify on-call lead if P1.
